start.title: Start new collection (unlicensed users)
start.description: Collect the prompt/response bodies of users without a Copilot license via Microsoft Purview eDiscovery. Specify the target user (UPN) and an optional time window, then start. Even for the same user and window, each start is tracked as a separate job that can be resumed independently. If the delegated login expires, collection stops; sign in again under Settings → Re-register permissions to continue.
